questions.question: Who will ask questions, and which answers would save them time?
questions.why: The test list should represent real work.

questions.question: Can you give examples of a simple question and one that needs several documents?
questions.why: This checks both lookup and combined answers.

questions.question: What must it say when the documents cannot answer a question?
questions.why: A clear boundary reduces confident guessing.

exit_criteria: Capture real questions, expected evidence and at least one out-of-scope example.

questions.question: Where are the documents now, and how often do they change?
questions.why: Search results depend on the copies being current.

questions.question: Which documents may only be seen by certain people?
questions.why: Answers must respect the same access limits.

questions.question: What should happen to old versions or withdrawn documents?
questions.why: Removed text should stop appearing in answers.

exit_criteria: Inventory sources, their owners, access limits and refresh cadence.

questions.question: What should a source link show so someone can check an answer?
questions.why: Users need enough detail to verify it.

questions.question: When two documents disagree, what should the person see?
questions.why: A conflict can be reported without choosing silently.

questions.question: How much waiting is acceptable for a typical answer?
questions.why: The design needs a testable response-time target.

exit_criteria: Record how users see sources, conflicting documents and missing answers.

questions.question: Which parts of a document should stay together so an answer keeps its context?
questions.why: This gives the retrieval design a useful unit to test.

questions.question: How soon after an edit should a changed document become searchable?
questions.why: The update target sets how much indexing work needs to happen at once.

questions.question: How much can you spend on making the documents searchable and keeping them current?
questions.why: A budget bounds the index size and refresh choices.

exit_criteria: Record testable document boundaries, update delay and an indexing budget.

questions.question: Who can judge whether an answer follows the documents?
questions.why: The evaluation needs a reliable reviewer.

questions.question: Which mistakes should cause a release to stop?
questions.why: Critical failures need a clear threshold.

questions.question: How do we check that changed documents show up in new answers?
questions.why: This proves the refresh path works.

exit_criteria: Confirm tests for retrieval, grounded answers, access and failure.

release_check.procedure: Install the release in a clean environment. Load the approved test corpus and capture one correctly sourced answer from the promised interface.
